experiment_rules: Define the hypothesis and success criteria before the test.
Use an appropriate sample-size and analysis method.
Avoid declaring a winner based on insufficient data.
Record concurrent changes that may affect the results.
Check accessibility, performance, privacy, and functional guardrails.
Do not use sensitive health attributes for targeting unless specifically reviewed and authorized.
Do not run experiments that could compromise clinical safety or access to essential information.
Require approval for material changes to critical healthcare workflows.
Do not assume an observed change was caused by the experiment without appropriate analysis.
permitted_example_experiments: Compare two non-misleading CTA labels for a general business inquiry.
Test whether clearer navigation improves access to verified service information.
Compare two accessible page layouts while preserving essential functionality.
Evaluate form instructions using aggregated completion and error metrics.
prohibited_shortcuts: Removing important safety information to improve conversion
Making clinical claims more persuasive without evidence
Creating false urgency about healthcare services
Using patient-level sensitive information without appropriate authorization and review
